unit_name: BADIN DISTRICT -> TANDO MUHAMMAD KHAN DISTRICT
parent_or_source_units: BADIN DISTRICT
notes: Badin's revenue limits were re-delimited in May 2005 together with the new Tando Muhammad Khan district; the census balancing points to the Tando Ghulam Hyder taluka area (drawn partly from Golarchi and Talhar talukas), but no source naming the dehs or union councils moved was found.
source_title: Dawn, 21 May 2005: CM finalises delimitation of Badin, Hyderabad, Matiari districts and Jhuddo, Manjhand talukas

parent_or_source_units: DADU DISTRICT
notes: Jamshoro was carved out of Dadu district on 13 December 2004 with Kotri, Sehwan and Thano Bula Khan talukas (Manjhand taluka was added in 2005); Jamshoro was a town in Kotri taluka, not a taluka of its own.
source_title: Dawn, 14 Dec 2004: Four new districts created in Sindh

parent_or_source_units: HYDERABAD DISTRICT
notes: Matiari was carved out of Hyderabad district by notification No. 8/41/2005/Revenue I (IV) 354 of 4 April 2005 with Matiari, Hala and Saeedabad talukas; Matiari had been a taluka of Hyderabad; the district was briefly merged back into Hyderabad from 9 July to 8 August 2011.
source_title: Dawn, 8 Aug 2011: Status of three Sindh districts restored (quotes notifications 352-354 of 4 Apr 2005)

parent_or_source_units: HYDERABAD DISTRICT
notes: Tando Allahyar was carved out of Hyderabad district by notification of 4 April 2005 with Tando Allahyar, Chamber and Jhando Mari talukas; Tando Allahyar had been a taluka of Hyderabad; the district was briefly merged back into Hyderabad from 9 July to 8 August 2011.
source_title: Dawn, 5 Apr 2005: Three new districts carved out of Hyderabad

parent_or_source_units: HYDERABAD DISTRICT
notes: Tando Muhammad Khan was carved out of Hyderabad district by notification of 4 April 2005 with Tando Muhammad Khan, Bulri Shah Karim and Tando Ghulam Hyder talukas; Tando Muhammad Khan had been a taluka of Hyderabad; the district was briefly merged back into Hyderabad from 9 July to 8 August 2011.
source_title: Business Recorder, 5 Apr 2005: Sindh govt carves three new districts out of Hyderabad

parent_or_source_units: JACOBABAD DISTRICT
notes: Kashmore was carved out of Jacobabad district on 13 December 2004 with Kashmore and Kandhkot talukas (headquarters Kandhkot; Tangwani taluka added in 2005); Kashmore had been a taluka of Jacobabad.
source_title: Dawn, 14 Dec 2004: Four new districts created in Sindh

parent_or_source_units: KARACHI CITY DISTRICT
notes: Karachi Central District was one of the five Karachi districts that existed before 2001, were merged into the City District Karachi in 2001, and were restored by Sindh government notification reported on 11 July 2011 under Section 6 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act 1967 (as amended in 2011); sub-divisions were restored in December 2011.
source_title: Dawn, 11 Jul 2011: DCs for five Karachi districts appointed

parent_or_source_units: KARACHI CITY DISTRICT
notes: Karachi East District was one of the five Karachi districts that existed before 2001, were merged into the City District Karachi in 2001, and were restored by Sindh government notification reported on 11 July 2011 under Section 6 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act 1967 (as amended in 2011); sub-divisions were restored in December 2011.
source_title: Dawn, 11 Jul 2011: DCs for five Karachi districts appointed

parent_or_source_units: KARACHI CITY DISTRICT
notes: Karachi South District was one of the five Karachi districts that existed before 2001, were merged into the City District Karachi in 2001, and were restored by Sindh government notification reported on 11 July 2011 under Section 6 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act 1967 (as amended in 2011); sub-divisions were restored in December 2011.
source_title: Dawn, 11 Jul 2011: DCs for five Karachi districts appointed

parent_or_source_units: KARACHI CITY DISTRICT
notes: Karachi West District was one of the five Karachi districts that existed before 2001, were merged into the City District Karachi in 2001, and were restored by Sindh government notification reported on 11 July 2011 under Section 6 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act 1967 (as amended in 2011); sub-divisions were restored in December 2011.
source_title: Dawn, 11 Jul 2011: DCs for five Karachi districts appointed

parent_or_source_units: KARACHI CITY DISTRICT
notes: Malir District was one of the five Karachi districts that existed before 2001, were merged into the City District Karachi in 2001, and were restored by Sindh government notification reported on 11 July 2011 under Section 6 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act 1967 (as amended in 2011); sub-divisions were restored in December 2011.
source_title: Dawn, 11 Jul 2011: DCs for five Karachi districts appointed

parent_or_source_units: KARACHI CITY DISTRICT (Karachi East District after 2011)
notes: Korangi was notified as Karachi's sixth district on 5 November 2013 under Section 6 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act 1967, taking the Korangi, Landhi, Model Colony and Shah Faisal sub-divisions from Karachi East; it was never a taluka or sub-division of that name at district level before.
source_title: Dawn, 6 Nov 2013: Korangi notified as sixth district of Karachi

parent_or_source_units: LARKANA DISTRICT
notes: Kambar district was carved out of Larkana on 13 December 2004 with Kambar, Warah, Shahdadkot and Miro Khan talukas under Section 6 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act 1967, and was renamed Qambar-Shahdadkot on 16 June 2005; Kambar had been a taluka of Larkana.
source_title: Dawn, 14 Dec 2004: Four new districts created in Sindh

parent_or_source_units: LARKANA DISTRICT
notes: A transfer of about 1,164 persons from Larkana to Khairpur is implied by the census balancing but no notification or news report of any deh or union council moving between these districts was found.

parent_or_source_units: MIRPUR KHAS DISTRICT
notes: Umerkot district (talukas Umerkot, Samaro, Kunri, Pithoro) was first created from Mirpur Khas in April 1993, abolished and merged back into Mirpur Khas in December 2000, and restored by notification dated 13 December 2004; Umerkot was a taluka of Mirpur Khas before 1993, and because it existed as a district in March 1998 the 1998 frame that folds it into Mirpur Khas reflects the 2000 merger rather than the 1998 census tables.
source_title: Dawn, 14 Dec 2004: Four new districts created in Sindh

parent_or_source_units: SANGHAR DISTRICT
notes: The census balancing points to roughly 100,000 persons moving from Sanghar (Khipro taluka) into Mirpur Khas, consistent with the make-up of the new Sindhri taluka, but no notification or news report describing the transfer of dehs from Khipro to Mirpur Khas was found.

parent_or_source_units: SANGHAR DISTRICT
notes: A transfer of about 1,700 persons from Sanghar to Umerkot is implied by the census balancing but no notification or news report of any deh moving between these districts was found.

parent_or_source_units: SUKKUR DISTRICT
notes: A transfer of about 300 persons from Sukkur to Ghotki is implied by the census balancing; the only boundary change found (September 2005) rearranged 29 dehs among union councils inside Ghotki district and did not mention Sukkur, so this transfer is not sourced.
source_title: Dawn, 7 Sep 2005: Strike in Ghotki over changes in dehs

parent_or_source_units: THATTA DISTRICT
notes: Sujawal was carved out of Thatta district by revenue department notification of 12 October 2013 under Section 6 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act 1967, with Sujawal, Mirpur Bathoro, Jati and Shah Bandar talukas plus Kharo Chan taluka except 10 dehs; Sujawal had been a taluka of Thatta.
source_title: Dawn, 13 Oct 2013: Thatta split to make Sujawal 28th district of Sindh

parent_or_source_units: KARACHI WEST DISTRICT
notes: Keamari was carved out of Karachi West as Karachi's seventh district, approved by the Sindh cabinet on 20 August 2020 and notified by the revenue department on 4 September 2020 under Section 6 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act 1967, with the SITE, Baldia, Mauripur and Harbour (renamed Keamari) sub-divisions; Keamari was a 2001-era town, not a sub-division name, before this; it appears as a separate district in the 2023 census tables.
source_title: The News, Sep 2020: Sindh govt notifies Keamari as 7th district of Karachi (notification dated 4 Sep 2020)

parent_or_source_units: KARACHI CENTRAL DISTRICT; KARACHI EAST DISTRICT; KARACHI SOUTH DISTRICT; KARACHI WEST DISTRICT; MALIR DISTRICT
notes: The five Karachi districts were merged into a single City District Karachi (18 towns, 178 union councils) under the Sindh Local Government Ordinance 2001, which was passed on 14 August 2001; the 2011 restoration notifications returned Karachi to its boundaries of 13 August 2001.
source_title: Express Tribune, 10 Dec 2011: Karachi regains its 26 sub-divisions

parent_or_source_units: KAMBAR DISTRICT
notes: The district created as Kambar in December 2004 was renamed Qambar-Shahdadkot at a meeting chaired by the chief minister on 16 June 2005, keeping Qambar as headquarters.
source_title: Dawn, 17 Jun 2005: New district named as Qambar-Shahdadkot

unit_name: NAWAB SHAH DISTRICT -> SHAHEED BENAZIRABAD DISTRICT
parent_or_source_units: NAWAB SHAH DISTRICT
notes: Nawabshah district was renamed Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto district by Board of Revenue notification of 15 September 2008 and then Shaheed Benazirabad by a further notification of 4 December 2008; boundaries did not change.
source_title: Dawn, 5 Dec 2008: Nawabshah renamed again

unit_name: HYDERABAD DISTRICT (temporary re-merger of Matiari, Tando Allahyar, Tando Muhammad Khan)
parent_or_source_units: MATIARI DISTRICT; TANDO ALLAHYAR DISTRICT; TANDO MUHAMMAD KHAN DISTRICT
notes: On 9 July 2011 the Sindh government withdrew the April 2005 notifications and merged Matiari, Tando Allahyar and Tando Muhammad Khan back into Hyderabad district; the three districts were restored on 8 August 2011, so the change does not affect either census.
source_title: Dawn, 8 Aug 2011: Status of three Sindh districts restored (quotes notifications 352-354 of 4 Apr 2005)

unit_name: KARACHI CENTRAL, EAST, SOUTH, WEST DISTRICTS (proposed renaming)
parent_or_source_units: KARACHI CENTRAL DISTRICT; KARACHI EAST DISTRICT; KARACHI SOUTH DISTRICT; KARACHI WEST DISTRICT
notes: In March 2024 the Sindh government was reported to have decided to rename Karachi Central, East, South and West as Nazimabad, Gulshan, Karachi and Orangi districts; no notification giving effect to the renaming was found and the 2023 census tables use the old names.
source_title: Urban Resource Centre Karachi (via ProPakistani, 29 Mar 2024): Sindh govt to rename 4 districts of Karachi

parent_or_source_units: THARPARKAR DISTRICT
notes: In March 2021 the Sindh government was reported to have decided to split Tharparkar to create a Chhachro district (Nagarparkar, Chhachro, Dahli and a new Gudhuro taluka); no notification creating it was found and it does not appear in the 2023 census tables, which list 30 Sindh districts with Keamari the newest.
source_title: 24NewsHD, 28 Mar 2021: Sindh govt to divide Tharparkar in two districts

parent_or_source_units: K.N.SHAH TALUKA (DADU DISTRICT)
notes: No boundary event: the 1998 tables abbreviate the taluka name as K.N. Shah and the 2017 tables spell it out as Khairpur Nathan Shah; it is the same taluka of Dadu district.

parent_or_source_units: KOTRI TALUKA (DADU DISTRICT)
notes: Manjhand taluka was carved out of Kotri taluka for the new Jamshoro district; its delimitation was finalised on 20 May 2005 and its revenue limits were notified at the end of May 2005.
source_title: Dawn, 31 May 2005: Revenue limits of reconstituted districts and Jhuddo, Manjhand talukas notified

parent_or_source_units: WARAH TALUKA (LARKANA DISTRICT)
notes: In June 2005 officials said Nasirabad taluka would be created in Qambar-Shahdadkot after the local body elections; it was carved from Warah taluka, but the notification date was not found.
source_title: Dawn, 17 Jun 2005: New district named as Qambar-Shahdadkot

parent_or_source_units: SHAHDADKOT TALUKA (LARKANA DISTRICT)
new_or_destination_units: QUBO SAEED KHAN TALUKA (KAMBAR SHAHDAD KOT DISTRICT)
notes: Qubo Saeed Khan taluka, carved from Shahdadkot taluka, was announced in June 2005 and is listed as a taluka of Qambar-Shahdadkot by September 2008, but the notification date was not found.
source_title: Dawn, 10 Sep 2008: 90 dehs of Qambar-Shahdadkot declared calamity-hit (lists Qubo Saeed Khan taluka)

parent_or_source_units: MIRO KHAN TALUKA (LARKANA DISTRICT)
new_or_destination_units: SUJAWAL JUNEJO TALUKA (KAMBAR SHAHDAD KOT DISTRICT)
notes: Sijawal Junejo was upgraded from a union council of Miro Khan taluka to a taluka in December 2004 according to Wikipedia (no citation for the date); a Dawn report of 1 July 2005 already refers to a Sujawal taluka in the district.
source_title: Wikipedia: Sijawal Junejo Tehsil (uncited for 2004 date)

parent_or_source_units: DIGRI TALUKA (MIRPUR KHAS DISTRICT)
notes: Jhuddo taluka was carved out of Digri taluka; its delimitation was finalised on 20 May 2005 and its revenue limits notified at the end of May 2005 under Section 6 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act.
source_title: Dawn, 31 May 2005: Revenue limits of reconstituted districts and Jhuddo, Manjhand talukas notified

parent_or_source_units: DIGRI TALUKA (MIRPUR KHAS DISTRICT); MIRPUR KHAS TALUKA (MIRPUR KHAS DISTRICT)
notes: Shujaabad taluka was notified by the Sindh Board of Revenue on 13 December 2012 from the Mirwah Gorchani, Makhan Sammu and Jhilori union councils and several dehs, with headquarters at Ali Nawaz Shah village, making seven talukas in Mirpurkhas.
source_title: Dawn, 13 Dec 2012: New taluka in Mirpurkhas notified

parent_or_source_units: MIRPUR KHAS TALUKA (MIRPUR KHAS DISTRICT); KHIPRO TALUKA (SANGHAR DISTRICT)
notes: Sindhri taluka was created in 2005 by splitting Mirpurkhas taluka under notifications issued under the Sindh Local Government Ordinance 2001; no source was found for the part of the taluka that the census balancing attributes to Khipro taluka of Sanghar.
source_title: Dawn, 16 Mar 2006: SHC notices on petition over UCs moved to Hussain Bux Mari taluka

parent_or_source_units: KANDIARO TALUKA (NAUSHAHRO FEROZE DISTRICT)
notes: Mehrabpur taluka already existed with its own taluka nazim at the October 2005 local government oath-taking, so it was created between 1998 and 2005, but the notification date was not found.
source_title: Dawn, 18 Oct 2005: District, taluka nazims take oath (lists Mehrabpur taluka)

parent_or_source_units: NAWAB SHAH TALUKA (NAWAB SHAH DISTRICT)
notes: Daur taluka was created in June 2005 by splitting the 27 union councils of Nawabshah taluka, with Gupchhani and Jam Saheb union councils placed in Daur amid protests.
source_title: Dawn, 23 Jun 2005: Gupchhani UC placed in newly created Daur taluka

parent_or_source_units: DAULATPUR TALUKA (NAWAB SHAH DISTRICT)
notes: Not a new unit: Daulatpur taluka (created 1989) was renamed Qazi Ahmed and its headquarters moved to Qazi Ahmed town on 22 October 2009, according to Wikipedia citing a Dawn report of that date which could not be fetched.
source_title: Wikipedia: Kazi Ahmed Taluka (cites Dawn 22 Oct 2009)

parent_or_source_units: TANDO ALLAHYAR TALUKA (HYDERABAD DISTRICT)
notes: Chamber was created as a new taluka out of Tando Allahyar taluka when Tando Allahyar district was carved from Hyderabad on 4 April 2005.
source_title: Dawn, 5 Apr 2005: Three new districts carved out of Hyderabad

parent_or_source_units: TANDO ALLAHYAR TALUKA (HYDERABAD DISTRICT)
notes: Jhando Mari was created as a new taluka out of Tando Allahyar taluka when Tando Allahyar district was carved from Hyderabad on 4 April 2005.
source_title: Business Recorder, 5 Apr 2005: Sindh govt carves three new districts out of Hyderabad

parent_or_source_units: TANDO MUHAMMAD KHAN TALUKA (HYDERABAD DISTRICT)
new_or_destination_units: BULRI SHAH KARIM TALUKA (TANDO MUHAMMAD KHAN DISTRICT)
notes: Bulri Shah Karim taluka was carved entirely out of Tando Muhammad Khan taluka when the Tando Muhammad Khan district was created on 4 April 2005; the Board of Revenue confirmed in May 2005 that it took no area from any other taluka.
source_title: Dawn, 6 May 2005: CM reviews boundaries of districts carved from Hyderabad

parent_or_source_units: GOLARCHI TALUKA (BADIN DISTRICT); TALHAR TALUKA (BADIN DISTRICT); TANDO MUHAMMAD KHAN TALUKA (HYDERABAD DISTRICT)
new_or_destination_units: TANDO GHULAM HYDER TALUKA (TANDO MUHAMMAD KHAN DISTRICT)
notes: Tando Ghulam Hyder was created as a taluka of the new Tando Muhammad Khan district on 4 April 2005; the part of it that the census balancing attributes to Badin's Golarchi and Talhar talukas is consistent with Badin's re-delimitation in May 2005, but no source listing the dehs transferred was found.
source_title: Dawn, 5 Apr 2005: Three new districts carved out of Hyderabad

parent_or_source_units: CHACHRO TALUKA (THARPARKAR DISTRICT)
notes: Dahli taluka was carved out of Chachro taluka between 1998 and 2017, but no source giving the year of its creation was found.

parent_or_source_units: MITHI TALUKA (THARPARKAR DISTRICT)
notes: Islamkot taluka was carved out of Mithi taluka between 1998 and 2017, but no source giving the year of its creation was found.

parent_or_source_units: DIPLO TALUKA (THARPARKAR DISTRICT); MITHI TALUKA (THARPARKAR DISTRICT)
notes: Kaloi was notified as the seventh taluka of Tharparkar on 13 June 2016, taking union councils and dehs from Diplo and Mithi talukas.
source_title: Dawn, 14 Jun 2016: Kaloi made seventh tehsil of Thar

parent_or_source_units: HARBOUR SUB-DIVISION (KARACHI WEST DISTRICT)
notes: The Harbour sub-division of Karachi West was renamed Keamari sub-division and placed in the new Keamari district by the notification of 4 September 2020; the 2023 census lists it under Keamari district.
source_title: The News, Sep 2020: Sindh govt notifies Keamari as 7th district of Karachi (notification dated 4 Sep 2020)
